name: Krypton
description: Set two generations before the destruction of the legendary Man of Steel’s home planet, Krypton follows Superman’s grandfather — whose House of El was ostracized and shamed — as he fights to redeem his family’s honor and save his beloved world from chaos.

videos.title: Discovering Krypton - Beginnings
videos.overview: See how the cast and crew of Krypton charted their own journey forth in the making of this epic series.

videos.title: Discovering Krypton - Epic In Scale
videos.overview: You may have some idea of where Superman is from, but Krypton is a much deeper dive into the mythology of a legend.

videos.title: Discovering Krypton - Romeo & Juliet
videos.overview: Is Rao-crossed lovers a thing? Because it is now. Go behind the scenes with the cast and crew of Krypton to learn more about Seg and Lyta's relationship.

videos.title: Discovering Krypton - Becoming Brainiac
videos.overview: Brainiac will haunt your dreams for many years to come. Watch Blake Ritson become the iconic Superman villain.

videos.title: Discovering Krypton - Crash! Bang! Wallop!
videos.overview: Big Action! Fight Sequences! Crazy Reveals! It's all coming up on Krypton. Here's to the Crash! Bang! Wallop!

videos.title: Discovering Krypton - Adam Strange
videos.overview: Meet Adam Strange! He's got no superpowers, but he may just be the key to save the greatest hero of all-time.

videos.title: Discovering Krypton - Generation K
videos.overview: From a rankless renegade to a planet-saving hero; the path of virtue is fraught with peril for our young hero.

videos.title: Discovering Krypton - What's Your Kryptonite?
videos.overview: So, Aaron, we've been meaning to talk. You and cake no longer have a healthy relationship and this is an intervention.

videos.title: Discovering Krypton - Not A Prequel
videos.overview: Superman might not exist! The fate of Krypton and its Last Son still remain in the balance.

videos.title: Discovering Krypton - The Fortress
videos.overview: What happens when a Superman superfan steps into the Fortress of Solitude for the first time? Pure emotion.

videos.title: Discovering Krypton - That "S"
videos.overview: The symbol of the House of El is so much more than an "S"; it's a symbol of hope.

videos.title: Discovering Krypton - Immigrant
videos.overview: He comes from the land of the ice and snow, with the crimson sun and the phantom zone.

videos.title: Discovering Krypton - Kneel Before Zod
videos.overview: We've met General Zod, but where do his allegiances lie? Will all of Krypton end up kneeling before Zod?

videos.title: Discovering Krypton - In Zod We Trust
videos.overview: The House of Zod is built upon constant and brutal tests of honor, but will all of its descendants uphold these principles?

videos.title: Discovering Krypton - Inside The Outlands
videos.overview: Cameron Cuffe battles real elements as he films Seg's life or death encounter with the barren, uninhabitable outlands.

videos.title: Krypton: 2017 Comic-Con Panel
videos.overview: This behind-the-scenes look delves into the story of Krypton's past.

videos.title: Bringing the Home World to Life
videos.overview: Explore the diverse and futuristic planet as an international team of artisans creates it from pure imagination.

videos.title: A Lost Kingdom: Life on Krypton
videos.overview: An exciting look at the power brokers of Kandor City.

videos.title: Villains: Modes of Persuasion
videos.overview: As an exploration of the needs, wants and desires that fuel the nefarious deeds perpetrated by your favourite DC villains.

videos.title: The Fate of Superman
videos.overview: Executive producer David S Goyer reflects on Kal-El's lineage as Seg balances the fate of his world against that of the entire universe.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: Superman's grandfather, Seg-El, learns Krypton is in danger of being destroyed so that his future grandson will never be born.

videos.title: House of El
videos.overview: After suffering a tragedy, Seg must adjust to a new life, a new rank and a new threat.

videos.title: The Rankless Initiative
videos.overview: During a military crackdown on Seg's home district, Seg and Adam Strange race to find a deadly Sentry.

videos.title: The Word of Rao
videos.overview: Seg is approached by a Black Zero leader as Rao finds a scapegoat for the failed Rankless Initiative.

videos.title: House of Zod
videos.overview: Jayna grapples with her torn loyalties as Seg fights for survival within the heart of Black Zero.

videos.title: Civil Wars
videos.overview: Seg is faced with an impossible choice that will shape the El legacy and the fate of the universe.

videos.title: Transformation
videos.overview: After a failed coup, Daron punishes the conspirators. Lyta and Dev go in search of Jayna.

videos.title: Savage Night
videos.overview: A resistance movement begins to form to impede the Voice of Rao's increasing power and influence.

videos.title: Hope
videos.overview: Seg must decide if he can make the ultimate sacrifice in service of the greater good of Kandor.

videos.title: The Phantom Zone
videos.overview: Seg races to save his city from being overtaken as the bottling of Kandor begins.

videos.title: Light-Years from Home
videos.overview: Seg-El is stranded far from home, where his grandfather leads a rebellion against General Zod.

videos.title: Ghost in the Fire
videos.overview: Adam Strange and Seg evade a bounty hunter, while General Zod uses Nyssa to further his cause.

videos.title: Will to Power
videos.overview: The Rebels gain advantage against General Zod, as Seg goes head-to-head with Brianiac.

videos.title: Danger Close
videos.overview: Seg and Adam return to a very different Kandor. Val and his Rebels prepare a major offensive.

videos.title: A Better Yesterday
videos.overview: Amidst a hostage negotiation that could end the war on Krypton, Seg seeks answers about Lyta.

videos.title: In Zod We Trust
videos.overview: In the wake of tragedy, Seg helps Nyssa rescue their son. Alliances on Wegthor fracture.

videos.title: Zods and Monsters
videos.overview: General Zod pushes for control of a dominating weapon. Seg and Nyssa fight to save Seg's life.

videos.title: Mercy
videos.overview: Dev and Jayna help Seg and Nyssa target General Zod's fleet, when they make a shocking discovery.

videos.title: Blood Moon
videos.overview: Zod brings Doomsday to heel and unleashes him on the Rebels, and Seg, Val, and Kem fight a last-ditch battle to hold the creature back while their compatriots escape.

videos.title: The Alpha and the Omega
videos.overview: The future of Krypton is at stake as Seg faces off against his enemy, General Zod, with the help of his allies.
